What codes guide development?

Jun 16, 2020
https://www.cityofeagle.org/m/FAQ#question-105
Land uses & development in Eagle are guided by four main sections on Eagle City Code: Title 8: Zoning: The zoning chapter regulates the use of all land under the jurisdiction of the City of Eagle and is established under Idaho Code  §67-6511.

What is the difference between a variance and a waiver?

May 20, 2021
https://www.cityofeagle.org/m/FAQ#question-112
Variance (Eagle City Code 8-7-4-2):A variance is a modification to the bulk and placement standards (setbacks, shape of structure) when the strict enforcement of code will create a hardship.
